statuses.meaning: The body of the HTTP request sent by the client is invalid. Ensure the HTTP request is using the specified Content-Type and length, and that the request is not missing (when an empty body is not allowed). Examples: Ping command (section 2.2.1.13) with a text/plain body, or SendMail command (section 2.2.1.17) with version 12.1 and a WBXML body.
